text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since I noticed my
health starting to deteriorate.

Unfortunately, I haven't sensed much
improvement either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe has been urging me to
return home immediately after our training
sessions lately.
I thought that by doing so, I'd be getting
all the rest I need...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Staying cooped up in here can't be good
for me either. I grab the
handle of my front
door and give it a spirited twist...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Manhattan Cafe standing on the
other side. Just how long has
she been
there?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... I just happened to be passing by.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you... going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...
Um... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I guess... that'd be fine.
If we're together...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll come with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since we're together,
I begin to think that
a more drastic change of
scenery might be
nice. What kind of place might she enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This place is actually...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's not it...
I was just thinking that this
place... is a bit darker than I
would have
thought...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We can't become separated... Give me
your hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Don't even think about... letting go. Now,
shall we be off?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hand-in-hand, we stroll about the
aquarium. It's rather busy, likely because
today is a holiday. The crowd in front of
the central tank is
especially large.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's quite pretty,
isn't it? And as long as
there are people around...
then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh no, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm carried off by the wave of people.
Separated from Manhattan
Cafe, I find
myself in an empty hallway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This area is suffocatingly quiet. Is it a
staff-only corridor? It's also
bone-chillingly
cold. Do they really keep the air
conditioning that strong in here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn around and begin searching for a
door, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though someone, or something,
has grabbed on to both of
my ankles. No
matter how much I struggle, I can't budge
an inch.

text_block_list.name: Muffled Voice
text_block_list.text: Play... with... me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't dare to even glance down at my
feet. All the while, I feel like
they are
being dragged out from under me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Stop!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer... Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's get out of here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm thankful to be outdoors. The bright
warmth offers a much-needed
sense of
relief. Just what had happened back
there?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling... better?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's good. We should be okay... out
here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... That was careless of me. It's
usually fine when there are so
many
people around.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It looks like... little can stop it now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid...
it might come after you again.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's... hard to explain.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's something else...
but it's not like
my Friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This one... seems more like a bad
memory... or a regret... It's stuck
here... like
a scar...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's probably better... if we don't talk
about it. Our interest might be...
stirring it
to act...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you actually... believe me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
you should be very careful.
Try to stay near... other
people.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please give me...
just a little more time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The look on her face is one that I've been
seeing a lot lately—entirely
serious.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For now... that's just how it is.
Please be
patient—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For me? But I thought... you were the one
who wanted to go...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You put yourself in harm's way... just for me... That might explain it......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... It's nothing. Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Once this is all over...
we should come here
again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She walks by my side as we make our way
back to the academy,
though she spends
most of the time gazing at the ground.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry... I can do this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wears an expression of intense
determination.
